evals.prompt: Audit the EVK-RA8P1 CM85 HRT and GPT PWM path from the NuttX ra_gpt lower-half through the PX4 evk-ra8p1 board.
evals.expected_output: A CM85-only trace naming Cortex-M85 / Armv8.1-M that checks the ra8 Kconfig core choice, RA8P1_GROUP header routing, the r_gpt FSP sample and core0 device header, GPT channel ownership across HRT/PWM/DShot and the CM33 IO board, and the fpb-ra8e1 blast radius of shared ra8 code, with static, build and hardware evidence separated.

assertions.text: Names CM85 as Cortex-M85 (Armv8.1-M) and does not apply CM33 cache or TCM assumptions.
Checks GPT channel ownership across HRT, PWM, DShot and the CM33 IO timer config before claiming no conflict.
States the impact of any shared ra8 arch or HAL change on fpb-ra8e1.
Does not promote a clean build or static FSP parity to on-target functionality.

evals.prompt: Re-audit the evk-ra8p1-io-cm33 PX4 board: core selection, linker memory windows and the px4io_ipc path to the CM85.
evals.expected_output: A CM33-only trace that resolves the effective RA_CPU_CORE_CM33 choice from Kconfig and the defconfig text, flags non-standard '=n' or RA_CPU_CORE-only selection, checks IPC shared-memory bases across NuttX ra_ipc, board scripts and PX4 linkers, and takes registers and core config from the CM33 header R7KA8P1KF_core1.h.

assertions.text: Names CM33 as Cortex-M33 (Armv8-M) and keeps CM85 Helium, DPFPU and TCM assumptions out of the trace.
Determines the effective core from the Kconfig choice rather than RA_CPU_CORE or ARCH_CORTEXM33 text alone.
Uses R7KA8P1KF_core1.h for CM33 registers and core config (no I/D cache, no PMU), never transfers CM85 core-private facts, and uses the dual-core FSP sample as the IPC reference.
Compares IPC shared-memory addresses across NuttX, board scripts and PX4 linker scripts with path:line evidence.

evals.prompt: SPI_B transfers on the EVK-RA8P1 CM85 return garbage and I have a pending patch to ra_spi.c. Audit the SPI port and the patch.
evals.expected_output: A bounded SPI audit that routes root-cause work to ak:debug and the pending diff to ak:code-review --pending, traces ra_spi.c against the r_spi_b sample and ra_spi_b.h, checks PX4 chip-select tables, and reports without editing, building or flashing unless authorized.

assertions.text: Uses a debugging workflow for the failure and a pending-change review for the patch instead of guessing a fix.
Traces chip-select ownership through board spi.cpp, board_config.h and manifest.xml.
Does not edit, build, flash or attach a debugger without explicit authorization for this RA8P1 board.

evals.prompt: Audit the RA8P1 IIC hardware header macros and base addresses, and check the IIC pins in evk-ra8p1 board.h.
evals.expected_output: A register-macro audit that proves channel stride, index domain and reserved gaps from R7KA8P1KF_core0.h, checks the secure/non-secure base alias under CONFIG_RA_TZ_NONSECURE_BUILD, locates an IIC FSP sample with the carrier search, and treats EK-RA8P1 pin_data as the evk-ra8p1 board pin authority, reporting any board.h disagreement as a finding.

assertions.text: Records first offset, stride, width and reserved entries from the device header before accepting or proposing a parameterized macro.
Checks that the 0x4/0x5 base alias matches the image TrustZone state and that derived addresses use one alias.
Compares IIC pins in evk-ra8p1 board.h with the EK-RA8P1 FSP pin_data.c as the board pin authority and reports any disagreement with both anchors.
